attempts.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: a transparent PNG vehicle illustration for a children's English vocabulary card, displayed at about 140 x 110 CSS pixels.

Input images:
Image 1 is the edit target: a tiny sage-green Mini-like two-door city car. Preserve its sage green color, very compact short body, rounded dome-shaped roof and two-door identity. Remove the original word "Mini".
Image 2 is the overall style reference: warm children's storybook commemorative-card illustration. Use its warm dark-brown hand-drawn outlines, soft painted paper texture, gentle volume and friendly warmth; do not copy its people or scenery.
Image 3 is an already completed car in the same vocabulary-card set. Match its softly painted illustration technique, warm brown contours, gentle highlights, right-facing slight front-side view and transparent asset presentation. Use it only for rendering consistency. Do NOT copy its long sedan proportions.

Primary request: redraw Image 1 as a polished, detailed children's storybook illustration of one sage-green, VERY SMALL, SHORT, ROUNDED TWO-DOOR city car. The body must be conspicuously shorter and more compact than the long sedan in Image 3. Keep a high rounded roof, short hood, tiny rear overhang, and one door on the visible side. The car should have the identity of a classic little Mini, not an SUV, not a sedan, and not a stretch vehicle. Preserve the cute compact silhouette while adding clear crafted details such as windows, a simple door handle, restrained headlights, and complete wheels.
Composition: front points RIGHT, viewed mainly from the side with only a mild glimpse of the front face. Center the complete car on a horizontal canvas. It should occupy about 84% of canvas width with at least 8% real transparent safety margin on the left and right and comfortable space above and below. Keep every wheel, mirror and body corner inside the canvas. Two main near-side wheels must be complete and grounded; a naturally occluded small part of a far wheel is acceptable, but no duplicate, floating or extra wheel.
Style and material: clean warm dark-brown hand-drawn outline, softly painted muted sage green body, subtle paper-like grain, gentle volume, restrained cream highlights, pale blue-green windows, warm brown dark tires. Keep the drawing warm and clear at vocabulary-card size. Warm soft light and a small softly fading grounding shadow immediately below the car.
Background: genuine transparent alpha. Only the car and a restrained semitransparent grounding shadow. No opaque backdrop, floor scene, paper rectangle or colored halo.
Text: NO TEXT anywhere. No word "Mini", no letters or numbers, no license-plate text, no badge, brand emblem, watermark or logo.
Avoid: photography, photorealism, glossy 3D toy rendering, simplistic geometric icon, plasticky materials, people, animals, scenery, border, frame, white sticker outline. Do not elongate the car. Do not crop the car.
